sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 10134047 (catx.py: 20 sites)

values.note: Single site $15/night (2 vehicles), double site $30 (4 vehicles), additional vehicle $5/night; interagency passes do not apply to the additional-vehicle fee. Same rate in and out of peak season (rec.gov rates 2026-2028).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/eagle-creek-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Double Site: $30 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per night') + recreation.gov /rates (Peak 2027-05-22 to 2027-09-02 and First-come 2027 seasons: single $15, double $30), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/eagle-creek-campground ('There are no hook-ups available.') + rec.gov catalog (all 20 sites NONELECTRIC, no water), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 18 single and 2 double sites; sites 19 and 20 sit by the horse corrals and are held for stock users until 4 pm, then first-come for one night. Not all sites are level; average spur 12' x 40'.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/eagle-creek-campground ('Camp sites: 20', 'unpaved sites that accommodate a maximum of 48' RVs', 'Campground road not suitable for vehicles longer than 48ft.', 'Trailer/RV sites Average Parking Spur:12' x 40''), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No water or sewer dump close to the campground; no trash pickup or firewood. Bear boxes at each site; horse corrals.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/eagle-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is not available at this site.', 'There is no water or sewer dump located close to the campground', 'Trash Pickup: No'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/eagle-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use: Open All Year', 'Operational Hours: Open year round.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservable in peak season (about May 22 - Sep 2) on Recreation.gov; first-come outside it. 16 of 20 sites are reservable; the 2 stock sites are first-come after 4 pm for one night. Rec.gov: 'Campground is usually full for most of the season. Don't expect the First come First serve sites to be unoccupied.'

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/eagle-creek-campground ('Reservations available for peak season on recreation.gov.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10134047 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 15; rate seasons 'Peak Season' / 'First-come, First-served Season') + catalog (16 reservable, 4 not), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF campground (Gardiner RD) 2 mi NE of Gardiner on gravel Jardine Road, overlooking Yellowstone NP's peaks; Yellowstone River Trailhead in the campground. Dispersed camping is prohibited along Jardine Rd near the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page and rec.gov: confirmed $15, 20 sites, 48-ft limit, no hookups, vault toilets, rec.gov booking. Changed season closes 09-07 -> year-round ('Open All Year'). Added fcfs some_sites (peak-season reservations, first-come otherwise and at the 2 stock sites), 15-night limit, no potable water, no dump. Forest Service-run (Gardiner RD). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: rec.gov gives (406) 848-7375 (Gardiner Ranger District).
Waterfront re-audit lead: the FS page opens 'A campground along the Yellowstone River'; rec.gov says the river is 'close by' and a small creek runs along the west side. Entry is 'not waterfront'.

Access-road alert (not a closure): Custer Gallatin order #01-11-03-26-01 (from 2026-07-09) imposes an open-fire ban on a 3.5-mile stretch of Jardine Road, the campground's access road; check whether it covers the campground's fire rings.
